decisions.reason: As a recent launch in a specialist segment that fits the firm's robust application-specific lighting business, management would continue it because the investment is fresh and any weak early uptake can still be attributed to normal market-development delays.

Although less central than some system products, the desk lamp was given its own page and supports the firm's ergonomic office-lighting positioning, so management would be inclined to persist rather than reverse a visible new-product commitment after only one year.

This is a core interior-lighting product with a dedicated page and explicit 'newly arrived' launch messaging, making it strategically central and publicly committed enough that management would strongly favor continuing it.

The pendant luminaire sits squarely in the firm's mainstream building-lighting offer, so a large established German manufacturer would likely keep backing it given the sunk development effort and the ease of explaining any slow start as temporary.

The marine HMI searchlight matches the firm's specialist and transport-related lighting capabilities, and management following escalation-of-commitment logic would maintain it because niche products often need more time to build demand.
